patch.summary: Grasshopper cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Grasshopper pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. 7-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Free plan: not confirmed in SG data
Entry paid tier researched: True Solo

blocks.heading: Grasshopper cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Grasshopper against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; 7-day trial documented.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (cloud phone, call routing, call recording) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite). Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Solo operators and tiny teams that primarily need a professional virtual number requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite)
Side-by-side cost with OpenPhone on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite)

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: IVR, recording and simultaneous ringing require Solo Plus or above

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: True Solo is capped at one user and one extension

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: US/Canada focus; limited CRM/CTI versus Aircall-class phones

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: No power dialer or WhatsApp Business API

blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Grasshopper on identical constraints.
